content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result:** INDEMN — **missing** (critical). The Agreement has no indemnification article: no Section 20 exists, and no defend/indemnify/hold-harmless language appears anywhere. Only downstream cross-references presuppose indemnities (§19.4, §19.5, §21.3 Excluded Claims, §29.2, §30.5), and §9.3 dangles on "the remedies required by Section 20.5."

**Cure (preferred level):** a single inserted Section 20 after §19.5 giving Vendor a duty to defend and indemnify us and our Affiliates for third-party claims arising from (a) IP infringement by the Services or Deliverables, (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, (c) Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; plus notice, control of defence, and reasonable cooperation, and our indemnity capped in scope to Customer-provided content and our breach of Applicable Law.

I chose preferred rather than the fallback because the fallback's 3× annual-fee super-cap would erode the uncapped treatment that §21.3 already gives indemnification obligations; the fallback remedies structure remains available if Vendor prefers to conform §9.3's Section 20.5 reference.
